summary: Frontend-only regression testing of COSMIC HORA mystical Vedic theme overhaul. All critical UI flows work end-to-end with the new Midnight Indigo + Saffron + Royal Gold palette, Playfair Display headings, sacred geometry backgrounds and glassmorphism cards. Hero celestial image loads (HTTP 200), 15 report cards render, admin login → /admin works, all 11 admin sidebar pages load with zero non-auth console errors, modals use exactly the rgba(5,3,15,0.72) overlay from spec, coupon + testimonial CRUD save/persist, i18n Hindi switch translates the H1. No dark-on-dark contrast bugs were detected on Home, Reports, Birth Form, Contact, Admin pages. Backend was NOT tested per request (iteration_2 already passed 100%).

issues: Date of Birth input uses browser's native picker (mm/dd/yyyy). Per design guidelines it should ideally use a shadcn calendar component for consistency with the mystical theme. Time-of-birth field also uses native --:-- input.
'+ NEW' add button and modal 'Save' button lack data-testid attributes (AdminCoupons has coup-add-btn/coup-save-btn, but AdminTestimonials.jsx does not). This makes automated E2E selection brittle.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to AdminTestimonials.jsx ('New' button and 'Save' button) for consistency with AdminCoupons and easier E2E testing.
(Optional/enhancement) Replace native <input type='date'> and <input type='time'> in BirthForm with a themed calendar/time picker to match the mystical dark aesthetic.

Cleanup residual seed data if any: coupon TESTCOUP01 and testimonial TEST_UserName were deleted via UI but confirm dialog auto-accept timing may have left one/both records. Verify via /admin/coupons and /admin/testimonials and manually delete if still present.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx line 56/71/112/130/144/165/186/198/224 use style={{color:'var(--obsidian)'}} which now maps to warm parchment ivory (#F5E9D3) — semantically confusing naming (var name says obsidian/black but is actually the light text color). Consider renaming the CSS variable for readability, though functionality is correct.

AdminTestimonials.jsx modal buttons ('New', 'Save') lack data-testid — inconsistent with AdminCoupons.jsx which has coup-add-btn/coup-save-btn. Apply same pattern across all admin resource modals (blog, faq, report-types, appointments, etc. should be audited).

Hero image at /generated/hero-celestial.png is 834 KB PNG — consider serving a WebP/AVIF version for LCP improvement (currently just decorative, no alt text needed since aria-hidden pattern already used on ZodiacWheel).
seed_data_creation: Created and (attempted) deleted: coupon TESTCOUP01 (15%), testimonial TEST_UserName. Screenshot suggests TEST_UserName may still be in DB; recommend manual verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only visual skin was changed; backend was untouched. Iteration_1 and iteration_2 both passed backend 100%. Focus for next iteration should be any new features or backend endpoint changes, not the theme. Key flows verified in this iteration: Home hero+zodiac wheel, /reports (15 cards), report detail → birth-form-page, admin login, all 11 admin sidebar routes, coupon + testimonial modal CRUD (backdrop = rgba(5,3,15,0.72) as specified), i18n Hindi. Contact form UI renders correctly; actual submission API was previously validated in iteration_2.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs to root-cause. Only two minor design/testability enhancements suggested above.
